identitySignals: Name matches a company registered in several states, including a California registration and a Columbia, MD address on its District of Columbia filing (OpenCorporates listing), matching the agenda's 'Columbia, MD'
Website elitegaminglive.com describes an esports league for grades 3-12 run through schools and organizations, matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' contracts
research.notes: Website does not state a headquarters and does not mention Oakland. Registry listings (OpenCorporates) show EliteGamingLIVE filings in MD, DE, NJ, CA and others with differing addresses (Baltimore, Brooklyn, Columbia MD), so the link between the website and the agenda's Columbia, MD entity is not independently confirmed. Web search budget was exhausted, so no SOS/SAM record could be read directly. Phone, address and registry IDs omitted. Not suitable for publication without review.

profile.summary: EliteGamingLIVE runs a competitive gaming league for students in grades 3-12. It uses esports to introduce young people to science, technology, engineering and math. It works with schools and youth organizations.
